objective: Adrian completes his first day of the male-fertility trial, establishing the baseline routine of medication intake and specimen collection while confronting the immediate physical and psychological costs of the regimen.
intendedChange: Adrian transitions from a desperate, exhausted student preparing for the trial to a participant who has successfully completed the first cycle, receiving his initial payment and experiencing the first subtle, confusing physical side effects of the drug.
prohibitedPatterns: Repeating the specific dialogue exchanges or internal monologue structures from the failed Chapter 4 attempt.
Resolving the long-term physical effects of the medication or revealing the nanite interaction.
Introducing the clinic's monitoring systems flagging anomalies in Adrian's samples.
Having the technician offer personal sympathy or break professional protocol.

scenes.purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic early, taking his first dose of the medication while managing acute nausea and the sterile, intimidating environment.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has ingested the medication and is physically present in the waiting area, experiencing the initial side effects of increased body heat and mild nausea, establishing the physical cost of the regimen.

scenes.purpose: Adrian undergoes the specimen collection process, enduring the clinical, dehumanizing nature of the interaction with the technician while risking a violation of timing protocols due to his physical distress.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has completed the specimen collection, maintaining his composure despite his vulnerability, and the technician has recorded the data, highlighting the power imbalance and the transactional nature of their dynamic.

scenes.purpose: Adrian receives his first payment and discovers the strict financial structure of the trial, realizing that the daily requirement leaves him with no time for his part-time job.
scenes.intendedChange: Adrian has accepted the loss of his part-time income to secure the trial's payment, committing fully to the regimen, and is returning to his apartment with a mix of relief and exhaustion, having established the baseline routine.
